messages.subject: error message in relation to inpmtime <= outmtime
messages.subject_clean: error message in relation to inpmtime <= outmtime
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mplusautomation Group,

I am using the package to run various efa, cfa, and multi-group CFAs. The package commands are embedded in functions and for for loops (yes, I know, for loops are slow and sloppy).

Unfortunately, I seem to be getting the error message once in awhile (I could not observe any regularities):
"Error in if (inpmtime <= outmtime) { :
  Missing value, where TRUE/FALSE is needed"

This occurs in case of efa and multi-group cfas. Once I rerun exacly the same script, right after, problem is usually resolved, or I get the same error message, but for a different model along the for loop. I have the hunch that maybe in the folder where I am dumping my mplus models, there might bee too many .inp and .out files, and the package has a hard time finding the file needed. I was wondering, has anyone else had this problem, and is there a quick fix for it.

I haven't prepared an example, as 1) I cannot get the error to systematically appear, 2) hoping there's a quick fix out there.

Here is my System information:
R version 3.3.0 (2016-05-03)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows 7 x64 (build 7601) Service Pack 1
Package version: MplusAutomation_0.6-3

Thanks in advance for your help,
Cheers,
Zsófia
